lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa surat sabad chit laae ||
lines.translation: Center your awareness on seva-selfless service-and focus your consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar sadaa sukh paaiaa maaiaa mohu chukaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Subduing your ego, you shall find a lasting peace, and your emotional attachment to Maya will be dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree satigur kai balihaaraniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, I am totally devoted to the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਜੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee paragaas hoaa jee anadin har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Divine Light has dawned; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man khoje taa naau paae ||
lines.translation: Search your body and mind, and find the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaavat raakhai thaak rahaae ||
lines.translation: Restrain your wandering mind, and keep it in check.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee baanee anadin gaavai sahaje bhagat karaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Night and day, sing the Songs of the Guru's Bani; worship the Lord with intuitive devotion. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਸੰਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: is kaaiaa a(n)dar vasat asa(n)khaa ||
lines.translation: Within this body are countless objects.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh saach milai taa vekhaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh attains Truth, and comes to see them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਦਸਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nau daravaaje dasavai mukataa anahad sabad vajaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Beyond the nine gates, the Tenth Gate is found, and liberation is obtained. The Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naaee ||
lines.translation: True is the Master, and True is His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ma(n)n vasaaee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sadaa rahai ra(n)g raataa dar sachai sojhee paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: Night and day, remain attuned to the Lord's Love forever, and you shall obtain understanding in the True Court. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: paap pu(n)n kee saar na jaanee ||
lines.translation: Those who do not understand the nature of sin and virtue

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai laagee bharam bhulaanee ||
lines.translation: are attached to duality; they wander around deluded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: agiaanee a(n)dhaa mag na jaanai phir phir aavan jaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: The ignorant and blind people do not know the way; they come and go in reincarnation over and over again. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te sadaa sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, I have found eternal peace;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai meraa thaak rahaaiaa ||
lines.translation: my ego has been silenced and subdued.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee mitiaa a(n)dhiaaraa bajar kapaat khulaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness has been dispelled, and the heavy doors have been opened. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Subduing my ego, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur charanee sadaa chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te man tan niramal niramal naam dhiaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, my mind and body are immaculate and pure; I meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਧੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan maranaa sabh tudhai taaee ||
lines.translation: From birth to death, everything is for You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bakhase tis de vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: You bestow greatness upon those whom You have forgiven.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai sadaa too(n) ja(n)man maran savaaraniaa ||8||1||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditating forever on the Naam, you shall be blessed in both birth and death. ||8||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh niramal agam apaaraa ||
lines.translation: My God is Immaculate, Inaccessible and Infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin takaRee tolai sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: Without a scale, He weighs the universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai soee boojhai gun kahi gunee samaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands. Chanting His Glorious Praises, he is absorbed into the Lord of Virtue. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sach laage se anadin jaage dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who are committed to Truth remain awake and aware night and day. They are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੈ ਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap sunai tai aape vekhai ||
lines.translation: He Himself hears, and He Himself sees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan lekhai ||
lines.translation: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, become acceptable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape laai lae so laagai guramukh sach kamaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: They are attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches; as Gurmukh, they live the Truth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਸੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis aap bhulaae s kithai hath paae ||
lines.translation: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads-whose hand can they take?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhiaa s metanaa na jaae ||
lines.translation: That which is pre-ordained, cannot be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jin satigur miliaa se vadabhaagee poorai karam milaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Those who meet the True Guru are very fortunate and blessed; through perfect karma, He is met. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: peeeaRai dhan anadin sutee ||
lines.translation: The young bride is fast asleep in her parents' home, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)t visaaree avagan mutee ||
lines.translation: She has forgotten her Husband Lord; because of her faults and demerits, she is abandoned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sadaa phirai bilalaadee bin pir need na paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: She wanders around continually, crying out, night and day. Without her Husband Lord, she cannot get any sleep. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: peeeaRai sukhadaataa jaataa ||
lines.translation: In this world of her parents' home, she may come to know the Giver of peace,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar gur sabad pachhaataa ||
lines.translation: if she subdues her ego, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sej suhaavee sadaa pir raave sach seegaar banaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Her bed is beautiful; she ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord forever. She is adorned with the Decorations of Truth. ||5||
